title: HSBall 솔로 #087 · 머슬아워글래스BBW · Thai Benjarong porcelain · 사지 뒤로 당김 + 앞 쇠공
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a medieval stone dungeon torture chamber with rough-cut stone block walls on each side of her, a low vaulted stone ceiling, iron torch sconces with flickering flames on the walls, old iron tools hanging on the stone wall, a damp flagstone floor, dark and moody firelight, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus from head to toe, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Subject: ONE real adult Swedish woman in her mid 20s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, very pale, cool skin, a soft white-silver highlighter along the cheekbones, nose bridge and brow bones, pale icy-blue eyeshadow with a fine silver shimmer, pale softly brushed blonde brows, curled light-brown-tipped lashes, large pale-blue eyes with bright real catchlights, a sheer frosted pale-pink lip, a quietly weary look, heavy eyelids and a faint tension at the corners of her lips, bold vivid violet-purple hair styled in vintage victory rolls framing the face, real living eyes. Long coffin nails, glossy finish.

Physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Huge rounded shoulders and thick, powerfully muscular arms with the swell of the muscle visible beneath a soft layer, a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size. Below that waistline a great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and drops down under its own weight, gathering into two or three heavy rounded folds, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, not pregnant. Enormous round hips more than three times the width of that waistline, colossal thighs with a muscular sweep visible beneath the fat, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Skin: Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a smooth taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh folds, faint stretch marks where the great curves have expanded. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Thai Benjarong porcelain — a black ground with five-colour jewel enamels in lotus-petal motifs, wide gold bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense tiered lotus-petal work filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her body below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line. The painted surface is scuffed and dulled along her hips, calves and forearms, rubbed away in a few worn patches at her elbows, inner thighs and ankles so her skin tone shows through, with flakes of pigment lifting at the edges. Soot smudges her brow, upper lip and cheeks, sweat runs in clean tracks through the grime on her face, black streaks cross her arms and legs, and her bare feet are filthy with dust and dirt.

Restraints: Her wrists wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, each ring linked by a thick chain of massive black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb, back and down to its own huge black iron ring bolted into the stone wall behind her at hip height on its own side. Her ankles wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, joined by a short chain of the same links, and from the middle of that short chain a long chain of the same links runs forward to a huge rough-cast black iron ball as big as a bowling ball lying on the flagstones in front of her, while a chain from each ankle runs back to its own huge black iron ring set in the flagstone floor at the base of the wall behind her, all the chains pulled dead taut so that she is drawn forward and backward at once.

Pose: standing full height, facing the camera, her torso leaning forward against the pull of the chains behind her, her arms drawn back and down along her sides, her shoulders pulled back, her head bowed slightly, her bare feet flat on the flagstones, her whole body straining, her chest, shoulders and stomach fully in view.

Footwear: bare feet flat on the flagstones, the soles, toes and tops of her feet streaked with soot and dirt.

Background & Lighting: the dim light catching the painted pattern in sharp glints, carving every fold and curve.

Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide. portrait 2:3 vertical.
